title: Make Array Zero by Subtracting Equal Amounts
summary: Given a non-negative integer array, repeatedly subtract the smallest non-zero element from all positive elements until all elements are zero.
statement: Given a non-negative integer array, repeatedly subtract the smallest non-zero element from all positive elements until all elements are zero. Return the count of such operations.
constraints: In one operation choose a positive x no larger than the smallest positive value and subtract x from every positive element.
Repeat until every element equals zero.
reference_solution:
def minimum_operations_to_zero(nums):
    return len({value for value in nums if value>0})
hints: Each operation can eliminate at most one distinct positive level relative to the lower levels.
Choose the current smallest positive level each time.
This shifts all remaining positives downward and removes exactly that distinct level.
Thus every distinct positive value is necessary and the greedy sequence achieves one operation per distinct value.
editorial: Thus every distinct positive value is necessary and the greedy sequence achieves one operation per distinct value.

tests.explanation: Choosing one, then two, then two eliminates the three distinct positive levels in three operations.
No operation is needed because the array is already zero.
